about_short_description.short_description: Lyve is a B2B SaaS platform empowering businesses to digitize their customers’ journey from order to payment to delivery.

product.name: Lyve Manage
product.description: A cloud-based delivery and workforce management platform offering real-time tracking, dynamic routing, scheduling, and geofencing to optimize last-mile delivery and decentralized workforce operations.

product.name: Lyve Order
product.description: An order management system that enables businesses to generate and manage orders across multiple channels, supporting direct-to-consumer sales and integration with existing workflows.

product.name: Lyve Pay
product.description: A secure cloud-based payment processing solution that facilitates reliable and safe payment acceptance for businesses.

product.name: Lyve Cross Border Delivery
product.description: A logistics solution enabling e-commerce businesses to manage and execute cross-border deliveries with real-time tracking and operational integration.
